review_type: Independent rendered review of the first seven module application labs and representative LMI print pages

final_machine_evidence.note: The machine run supplies interaction/lifecycle evidence; this independent review adds human inspection of the exact rendered bytes.

screen_review.observation: Both widths show the complete commissioning setup, peak-versus-probability distinction, sampled thermal recurrence, common-mistake warning, fleet-risk exercise and atomic CVaR exercise with separate expanded hints and worked solutions. Degree-Celsius and kilowatt units are readable; no capture overlay remains.

Both widths show the state normalization, two-by-two plant and residual matrices, certified-disk limitation, startup-box exercise and disturbance-tube exercise. Matrix signs, superscripts, physical temperature units and all expanded solution text are readable. Its long residual identity uses a contained mobile horizontal scroller, separately checked at both endpoints.

Both widths show the kernel/regularization setup, posterior solve, variance-versus-standard-deviation distinction and Celsius decision margin. The repeated-measurement and bounded-discrepancy exercises retain visible separate hints and complete solutions, including the conditional-event limitations.

Both widths show the seed-based safe-set update, distinct lower/upper interval roles, admissible next measurement and separate thermal/vibration margins. The two expanded exercises preserve mm/s and gain-error units, and the implementation-reserve arithmetic is readable.

Both widths show the deterministic bounded-noise cones, joined safe intervals and admissible proposals. The implementation-interval exercise and finite-horizon Gaussian noise exercise have readable expanded hints/solutions; deterministic and probabilistic assumptions remain visually explicit.

Both widths show weighted state distance, metre and velocity units, measurement-error/latency reserves, the accepted and rejected switching points, and the complete monitoring-period/library exercises. The common-mistake box and conditional-backup scope are readable. The obsolete focused skip-link capture overlay is absent.

Both widths show kernel pruning, the controlled-invariance interpretation, safe-cycle value, finite penalty and unsafe-tie explanation. The relaxed-cap and changed-discount exercises retain readable separate hints and worked solutions. Its long safe-cycle value expression uses a contained mobile horizontal scroller, separately checked at both endpoints.

mobile_wide_equation_review.method: An additional read-only Playwright session at 390×900 opened each application and inspected display-math scroll containers. For the two overflowing displays, left and right endpoint screenshots were generated in /tmp and manually viewed at original resolution.
mobile_wide_equation_review.other_five_labs: No overflowing display-math container at 390 px in this additional check.

print_visual_review.method: pdftotext located the application at pages 51–54; pdftoppm rasterized pages 1, 51, 52, 53, 54, 69 at 110 dpi, and each complete page was viewed at original raster resolution.

page_observations.1: Title, prerequisites and study route have readable spacing and visible page margins; navigation controls are absent.
page_observations.51: The prior plotted example is readable, followed by the application title, learning objectives and commissioning setup.
page_observations.52: Plant/residual matrices, Lyapunov calculation and physical-unit interpretation remain fully visible within the page width. The final starting-state paragraph continues correctly onto 53.
page_observations.53: The continuation, certificate limitation, warning and entire startup exercise including hint and worked solution are readable.
page_observations.54: The full disturbance-tube question, hint, solution and synthesis are readable, with the old graded-practice introduction following.
page_observations.69: Reference-table columns and the current flashcard front remain readable, with visible lower margin.

print_visual_review.assessment: No text or equation clipping was found in the six inspected pages. Both new LMI exercise solutions are present and expanded; page continuations retain the mathematical argument.

limits: Visual PASS applies to these seven application bodies at 390/1280 and the six listed print pages, not every original chapter paragraph or all 69 PDF pages.

Content captures intentionally hide fixed menu/skip controls; this reviewer did not visually inspect page-title/mobile-control overlays. The root machine runner checks those separately with controls visible.
This is readability/layout review, not a new mathematical proof, physical-model validation or exhaustive correctness audit of interactive numerical explorers.

Printed interactive explorers and flashcards retain their current state; the last-page flashcard front is visible, and this review does not claim that the whole deck or every dynamic state appears in the PDF.
Temporary PDF rasters and scroll-endpoint captures in /tmp are inspection aids. The final artifact map contains only the 15 canonical root-run PNG/PDF files.
